title: SkyScraper
description: Skyscraper pairs multi-temporal PlanetScope and Sentinel-2 satellite imagery sequences with GDELT-derived news event captions and article text, released as two parallel per-sensor bundles with joined labels, imagery stacks, and per-event metadata for multimodal Earth-observation/text research.

## README.md
# Skyscraper

Multi-temporal Earth-observation imagery with GDELT-linked news text: each example ties geolocated **PlanetScope** or **Sentinel-2** image sequences to event-centric captions and article metadata.

Machine-readable documentation for this release lives in [`croissant.json`](croissant.json) ([Croissant](https://mlcommons.org/working-groups/data/croissant/) 1.1, including Responsible AI fields).

## Source Cooperative

| Resource | URL |
|----------|-----|
| Product listing | [source.coop/planet/skyscraper](https://source.coop/planet/skyscraper) |
| PlanetScope bundle | [source.coop/planet/skyscraper/gdelt-planetscope](https://source.coop/planet/skyscraper/gdelt-planetscope) |
| Sentinel-2 bundle | [source.coop/planet/skyscraper/gdelt-sentinel](https://source.coop/planet/skyscraper/gdelt-sentinel) |

Download layout should match the directory tree below so paths in `croissant.json` resolve correctly.

## Layout

Place `croissant.json` next to two parallel bundles (same schema, different sensors):

```text
skyscraper/
├── README.md
├── croissant.json
├── gdelt-planetscope/
│   ├── labels.csv
│   ├── imagery/
│   │   └── <article_id>/*.jpg
│   └── metadata/
│       └── <article_id>/metadata.json
└── gdelt-sentinel/
    ├── labels.csv
    ├── imagery/
    │   └── <article_id>/*.jpg
    └── metadata/
        └── <article_id>/metadata.json
```

- **`labels.csv`** — One row per record; join key is **`article_id`** (matches imagery and metadata folders).
- **`imagery/`** — JPEG stacks per `article_id`.
- **`metadata/`** — Per-event JSON; may include extended or model-derived fields (see `croissant.json` provenance notes).

## Labels (`labels.csv`)

Both bundles use the same columns:

| Column | Role |
|--------|------|
| `article_id` | Integer ID; directory name under `imagery/` and `metadata/` |
| `event_type` | Event category |
| `event_caption` | Text description of the event / visible change |
| `visible` | Whether the event is marked visible in the release |
| `sequence_start_date`, `sequence_end_date` | Satellite sequence window |
| `event_start_date`, `event_end_date` | Event time window (may be empty) |
| `location_name` | Place description |
| `coordinates` | Encoded lat/lon (format as produced by the pipeline) |
| `source` | Sensor/source tag (e.g. planet / sentinel) |
| `api` | Basemap or API used for context (e.g. mapbox) |
| `url` | News article URL |
| `article_content` | Article body text included in the export |

## License

This release is described in `croissant.json` as **CC BY-NC 4.0**:  
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/

Upstream constraints still apply: **Planet** imagery, **Copernicus Sentinel-2**, **GDELT**, and **news publishers** each impose their own terms. Redistributing or displaying full article text must respect those sources.

## Citation

Use the bibliographic entry from the accompanying paper when available. The dataset record also includes a `citeAs` string in [`croissant.json`](croissant.json).

## Responsible use

Limitations, biases, sensitivity of locations and news text, and recommended use cases are summarized in the **RAI** and **provenance** sections of [`croissant.json`](croissant.json). The dataset is intended for research (e.g. multimodal EO–text modeling), not for surveillance, individual identification, or high-stakes operational decisions without validation.

## Loading via Croissant (optional)

With [mlcroissant](https://github.com/mlcommons/croissant) installed and data paths matching this README:

```python
from pathlib import Path
from mlcroissant import Dataset

ds = Dataset(jsonld=Path("croissant.json"))
# Iterate record sets (e.g. records_planetscope, records_sentinel) per library docs
```

Record streaming may require the full data tree present locally or an archive layout consistent with the `includes` patterns in `croissant.json`.
